deciding.under_dosed: 86.6 L against 100 L planned for 100 drippers is about 13% short, with no override. The assumed count of 90 means part of the gap could be a set-up error.
deciding.emitter_clogging: Pressure is normal and the valves are fully open, but per-dripper delivery is low and drain is very low. The count mismatch gives a plausible alternative explanation.
deciding.next_action: Normal pressure, full valve opening, no pending test and near-zero drain make a physical emitter fault the likely reading. The count mismatch leaves some doubt.
deciding.drain_deviation: Mean drain is 2.5% against a 20-30 band, so it is about 17.5 points under, which is over 15.
deciding.off_plan_cycles: Three cycles at 16.6 L are about 17% under the 20 L plan. The 17.9 L cycle is 10.5% under, and the 18.9 L cycle is within tolerance. Whether the 17.9 L cycle counts decides between two and three.
